newsitem.title: SOUTH AFRICA: S.African Airways loses bid to halt BA deal.
newsitem.headline: S.African Airways loses bid to halt BA deal.

text.p: A formal complaint by South African Airways against a tie-up between British Airways Plc (BA) and local South African carrier Comair has been overuled, the two allied airlines said in a statement on Tuesday.
The airlines sealed a franchise agreement last year, but SAA protested to the International Air Services Council and the Domestic Air Services Franchises Licensing Council.
SAA said the deal allowed BA to in effect become a South African domestic operator without an appropriate license.
The statement said both organisations had turned down the objections.

"This ruling validates the franchise agreement between British Airways and Comair and clearly indicates that no South African legislation has been infringed," said Pieter van Hoven, managing director of British Airways/Comair.
"We can continue to develop the British Airways franchise with confidence," he added.
